acceptance_conditions: Only authentication-free official ONS, Ordnance Survey or local-authority public UPRN/address sources are accepted
Official item, package, service, licence, access time and checksum evidence is recorded
Search and download concurrency remains bounded to no more than 15 workers and no more than 4 large downloads
UPRN, address or postcode proximity alone cannot promote the row
Promotion requires an exact non-derived parent parcel/source identifier to UPRN or address binding
The exact bound identifier must independently resolve to agreeing official LSOA 2011 and LSOA 2021 codes
Unavailable, restricted, paid, CAPTCHA or authentication-only sources are recorded fail-closed and skipped
No majority vote, nearby-record inference, threshold relaxation or parent value/score mutation is allowed
JSON, HTML, queue task, status, evidence and manual-action records are updated
Canonical push and remote hash readback must succeed before COMPLETED_PUBLISHED
